{{Top|leg}}
'''Bio-caps''' were used to cover the end of a severed limb while a replacement prosthetic was being readied for installation. [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Modigal Glave]] had a bio-cap placed on the stump of his forearm after losing his hand. Having a bio-cap in place was still extremely painful for the wearer.
